title: Home holdings and covariance
hook: Two stated cases: explore the diversification channel under specified covariance.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the diversification channel under specified covariance affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines SD, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the diversification channel under specified covariance in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy portfolio puts weight 1 in an asset with SD 0.2, the rest in one with SD 0.2; correlation 0.2. What is portfolio SD?

claims.text: Covariance contributes to portfolio risk. Equal component risks do not imply equal portfolio risks when correlations or weights differ. This comparison isolates the diversification channel under specified covariance.
